We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

5. Cookies and Tracking

  • Recognize returning visitors.

  • Remember your preferences.

  • Enable secure login sessions and protect your account from unauthorized access.

You can control cookies via your browser settings.

At SRV Electricals, we are committed to delivering your orders in a timely, safe, and cost-effective manner. This Shipping Policy outlines the terms and conditions regarding shipping and delivery of products ordered through our website or via authorized sales channels.

1. Shipping Coverage

We ship products across India, including Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and other regions. International shipping is not currently available.

  • All orders are processed within 2–4 business days after order confirmation and successful payment.

  • Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

  • Delays may occur due to high demand, weather conditions, or courier issues. We appreciate your patience during such events.

  • Exact charges will be displayed at checkout before payment confirmation.

5. Order Tracking

  • Once your order is shipped, a tracking number and courier partner details will be sent via email/SMS.

  • You can track the shipment status on the courier’s website using the tracking ID provided.

  • Our courier partners will make up to 3 delivery attempts.

  • If unsuccessful, the order may be returned to us and additional charges may apply for reshipment.

  • If your package is damaged during transit, please refuse delivery and contact us immediately with photos.

  • For lost shipments, we will initiate an investigation with the courier and keep you informed.

What are TPN MCB Distribution Boxes?

TPN distribution boxes, meaning Triple Pole Neutral distribution boxes, are critical components in electrical distribution systems. They provide a safe and effective way to manage three-phase electrical circuits, ensuring that power is distributed evenly and consistently. Each box includes a neutral pole along with three circuit breakers, offering reliability and protection against faults. These features are essential for both residential and commercial applications, making TPN boxes a preferred choice for many engineers.

Benefits of Using TPN MCB Distribution Board

Using TPN distribution boxes comes with numerous benefits. First, they enhance electrical safety because they can prevent overloads and short circuits effectively. Additionally, these boxes facilitate better load management, allowing for a balanced electrical load across all three phases. Because of their robust design, TPN distribution boxes also reduce maintenance costs and extend the life of your electrical systems, making them a smart investment for any facility.

Applications of TPN MCB Distribution Board

TPN distribution boxes are commonly employed in various settings, including industrial plants, commercial buildings, and residential complexes. Their ability to manage three-phase systems with a neutral makes them versatile and essential for high power applications. Therefore, they are often used in machinery, HVAC systems, and large-scale electrical installations. By understanding their applications, users can better appreciate why investing in quality TPN distribution boxes is so important.


What is a TPN MCB Distribution Board?

A TPN MCB Distribution Board is a crucial component in electrical systems, especially in industrial and commercial applications. It is designed to efficiently manage and distribute electrical power while ensuring safety. Because of its robust design, it protects circuits from overload and ensures reliable operation, making it an essential choice for modern electrical installations.

Key Features of TPN MCB Distribution Boards

These distribution boards are available in configurations of 4 Way, 6 Way, and 8 Way, offering versatility for various applications. They come with double door designs, which provide easy access for maintenance and inspection while keeping the internal components secure. Additionally, the TPN MCB distribution boards ensure superior performance and safety by integrating Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCB) that automatically disconnect circuits in case of faults, thereby protecting both equipment and personnel.

Why Choose TPN MCB Distribution Boards?

Choosing a TPN MCB distribution board ensures optimal performance in multi-phase electrical systems. Its design and features reduce the chances of electrical mishaps, making it a reliable option for both residential and industrial purposes. Moreover, the easy installation and maintenance of these boards save time and money in the long run. This makes the TPN MCB distribution board an excellent investment for any serious electrical setup.
